<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915857_theRebbe_394" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915857_theRebbe_394__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the heading and date for the maamar delivered on Motzaei Shabbos Parshas Mikeitz, Shabbos Chanukah, 5738.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Motzaei Shabbos Parshas Mikeitz,</t>
    <t s="2">Shabbos Chanukah,</t>
    <t s="3">5738*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section introduces the dispute between Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel regarding the order of lighting Chanukah candles, questions the connection to the Sukkos bull-offerings, and raises difficulties about the eight days, the number of lights, and the time of lighting.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The Sages taught: The mitzvah of the Chanukah light... Beis Shammai says: On the first day one lights eight, from there onward decreasing; and Beis Hillel says: On the first day one lights one, from there onward increasing.</t>
    <t s="1">The reason of Beis Shammai is corresponding to the bull-offerings of the festival [of Sukkos], and the reason of Beis Hillel is that we ascend in holiness...1.</t>
    <t s="2">And known is the precise question of the Alter Rebbe2,</t>
    <t s="3">What is the connection of the Chanukah light to the bull-offerings of the festival?</t>
    <t s="4">And especially according to what the Tzemach Tzedek wrote3,</t>
    <t s="5">That even Beis Hillel only disagree because of "we ascend in holiness."</t>
    <t s="6">And what is explained in many places4</t>
    <t s="7">That the connection of Chanukah to Sukkos is that both are eight days,</t>
    <t s="8">For the number eight indicates a level that is above the chain of descent5,</t>
    <t s="9">This itself requires explanation,</t>
    <t s="10">What is the connection of Sukkos and Chanukah to the level that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="11">Because of which they are eight days.</t>
    <t s="12">And also,</t>
    <t s="13">Since the institution of the Chanukah lights was because of the miracle that occurred with the lights of the Sanctuary,</t>
    <t s="14">And since in the Sanctuary there were seven lights,</t>
    <t s="15">Why are there eight lights in Chanukah</t>
    <t s="16">(and days)6.</t>
    <t s="17">And also one must understand that which the comparison</t>
    <t s="18">(the parallel)</t>
    <t s="19">of the Chanukah lights is</t>
    <t s="20">(not to the festival of Sukkos in general,</t>
    <t s="21">but rather)</t>
    <t s="22">specifically to the bull-offerings of the festival,</t>
    <t s="23">For ostensibly,</t>
    <t s="24">the Chanukah lights are related to the Menorah</t>
    <t s="25">(the Chanukah lights are because of the miracle that occurred with the lights of the Menorah),</t>
    <t s="26">and the bull-offerings of the festival were offered</t>
    <t s="27">(like all sacrifices)</t>
    <t s="28">upon the Altar,</t>
    <t s="29">and the Menorah and the Altar are two different vessels7</t>
    <t s="30">[And especially according to what is explained in Kabbalah and Chassidus8],</t>
    <t s="31">and lights and sacrifices are different services,</t>
    <t s="32">To the extent that "yours</t>
    <t s="33">(the lights)</t>
    <t s="34">is greater than theirs</t>
    <t s="35">(the sacrifices)</t>
    <t s="36">... they are never nullified"9.</t>
    <t s="37">And also one must understand that which its mitzvah</t>
    <t s="38">(of the Chanukah light)</t>
    <t s="39">is from sunset1,</t>
    <t s="40">For the precise point regarding this is known10,</t>
    <t s="41">That the lights of the Sanctuary were lit from plag haminchah,</t>
    <t s="42">an hour and a quarter before sunset11,</t>
    <t s="43">And since the Chanukah lights are</t>
    <t s="44">(as above)</t>
    <t s="45">because of the miracle that occurred with the lights of the Sanctuary</t>
    <t s="46">[And especially since whatever the Sages instituted, they instituted in the manner of Torah law12],</t>
    <t s="47">It would seemingly be fitting that the time of their lighting be like the lights of the Sanctuary,</t>
    <t s="48">And why is its mitzvah specifically from sunset.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the essence of the Chanukah lights is to illuminate the darkness, which is why they are lit specifically at sunset and are eight in number, representing a level above the chain of descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B)</t>
    <t s="1">And the point of the explanation regarding this13,</t>
    <t s="2">Is that the essence of the Chanukah lights is to illuminate the darkness.</t>
    <t s="3">For, behold, the miracle of Chanukah occurred after the Greeks entered the Sanctuary and defiled all the oils that were in the Sanctuary1,</t>
    <t s="4">That the strengthening of the darkness</t>
    <t s="5">(of the Greeks)14</t>
    <t s="6">was to such an extent,</t>
    <t s="7">That not only did they enter the Sanctuary and defile it,</t>
    <t s="8">But they also defiled all the oils that were in the Sanctuary.</t>
    <t s="9">For oil is a level of holiness</t>
    <t s="10">(as it is written15</t>
    <t s="11">"oil of sacred anointment")16,</t>
    <t s="12">"Holy" is a term in and of itself17</t>
    <t s="13">(similar to oil that floats18</t>
    <t s="14">on top of all other liquids and does not mix with them)19.</t>
    <t s="15">From this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="16">That this defiling of all the oils in the Sanctuary</t>
    <t s="17">touches upon</t>
    <t s="18">(in particular this)</t>
    <t s="19">even more than their defiling of the Sanctuary,</t>
    <t s="20">Even though the holiness of the Sanctuary is an exalted level among the ten levels of holiness20.</t>
    <t s="21">And as is also proven from the fact that even after "Your children came... and purified Your Sanctuary"21,</t>
    <t s="22">Behold, in order to be able to light the Menorah they specifically needed a miracle,</t>
    <t s="23">Beginning from the miracle22</t>
    <t s="24">That they found one cruse of pure oil sealed with the seal of the Kohen Gadol23,</t>
    <t s="25">The light of Ein Sof that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="26">Regarding which light even24</t>
    <t s="27">"darkness does not darken,"</t>
    <t s="28">And on the contrary, this light illuminates the darkness so that even the darkness will shine,</t>
    <t s="29">And "it will be"25</t>
    <t s="30">(with the addition of a Vav)</t>
    <t s="31">"my darkness will shine"26.</t>
    <t s="32">And this is that the mitzvah of the Chanukah light is specifically from sunset,</t>
    <t s="33">Because the essence of the Chanukah lights is to illuminate the darkness.</t>
    <t s="34">And this is also that the Chanukah lights are specifically eight</t>
    <t s="35">(and likewise the days of Chanukah are eight27),</t>
    <t s="36">For the number eight indicates</t>
    <t s="37">(as above in section 1)</t>
    <t s="38">a level that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="39">For it is specifically by means of this level that it is possible to illuminate even the darkness28.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
